mentions.name: GnuCash Transaction Import Mini-App
mentions.description: A custom Python/Django mini-app for importing transactions into a local GnuCash install. It translates and categorizes transactions from non-English source documents into English GnuCash entries, aiming to cut data-entry time by at least 90%, and includes human-error prevention to catch wrong numbers or accounts that previously took long to reconcile.
mentions.problem: Manual GnuCash transaction entry was so tedious that after over two years the author missed three consecutive months, and entry errors repeatedly took more than 15 minutes to reconcile.
mentions.source_excerpt: A custom Python/Django based mini-app (mini — at least for now) that will allow me to import transactions sanely and safely to my local GnuCash install.

evidence.value: A custom Python/Django based mini-app (mini — at least for now) that will allow me to import transactions sanely and safely to my local GnuCash install.
